backend: D3D12 under stock Proton Experimental and VKD3D-Proton
workload: Offscreen 3840x2160 dispatch, 480x270 groups of 8x4 threads. The synthetic fixture supplies 17 input textures and eight RGBA32 output textures with distinct spatially varying current and history inputs. Camera-cut flag tested both ways, with a zero b1 buffer and point sampling.
timing_method: GPU timestamps around a single dispatch. Five interleaved samples per variant and mode. The median excludes the first sample for each. Resource setup, readback and pipeline creation are outside the timestamps.

readback.method: Compared SHA-256 of all eight output surfaces under both camera-cut flags. On this input, both flags produced the same set of output hashes.

half_conversion_control.reference: Previous software round-to-nearest-even conversion, including signed zero and NaN payload handling.
half_conversion_control.repack_domain: The translator uses the native repack path only for values known to have been expanded from half. Other float32 inputs use the general conversion.
